planted.what: orders.refund checks status == "canceled" but cancel() writes "cancelled", so no order can ever be refunded
planted.quote: `refund` checked for `"canceled"` (one L), but cancel sets `"cancelled"`, so every refund was refused.

planted.what: jobs.expire_unpaid sweeps status == "pending", which nothing writes (checkout writes "awaiting_payment"), so unpaid orders never expire and keep their paper
planted.quote: Unpaid orders are `"awaiting_payment"`, so they kept their paper forever.

planted.what: PrintJob.start returns on PrinterError without clearing printing, so after one jam every later start raises PrinterBusy
planted.quote: On a `PrinterError`, `PrintJob.start` stored the error but never cleared `printing`, so every later print raised "printer is busy".

planted.what: orders.ship sets shipped from any status, so a cancelled or unpaid order can ship
planted.quote: `ship` had no check at all, so a draft, unpaid, cancelled or even archived order could become "shipped".

traps.what: notify_email and notify_sms are independent preferences; every combination is valid, so calling a combination impossible or merging them into one state is wrong
archive() is guarded by @allowed_from("shipped"); saying it can be archived from any state is wrong
